title: Benchmarking large language models for geolocating colonial Virginia land grants

model.params_source: paper Appendix A.2 Table A1 (M-2: one_shot pipeline, reasoning effort medium; o-series at service defaults, Sec. 4.5); max_tokens 16384 (maps to max_completion_tokens) instead of null because the runner cannot build a reasoning-model request from a null value

task.subset_rule: paper-defined split: the 43 grants with verified ground truth (hook load_items; recomputing the released M-2 per-grant errors over these 43 rows gives 23.39 km = Table 4)
task.approximation: the position of the abstract relative to the printed instruction (appended after it) is assumed; unparsable replies are excluded from the mean and counted

items.source: https://github.com/ryanmio/colonial-virginia-llm-geolocation, file data/processed/validation.csv (45 rows, 43 with ground truth); corpus archive Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.16269949 is access-restricted
items.license: unknown (repository LICENSE file not read; Zenodo record is CC BY-NC 4.0)

fields_prose.label: latitude/longitude (verified centroid of the matched patent polygon)

items.filter_prose: hook: rows whose results_row_index is marked is_locatable == 1 in results/full_results.csv (43 rows = the paper's verified test grants; test_entry_17 and test_entry_98 are the two has_ground_truth rows the paper excluded)

prompt.few_shot: none beyond the single exemplar output format inside the instruction (Sec. 4.5 'one-shot')
prompt.verbatim: partial (instruction verbatim; where the abstract is inserted is not printed)

output.postprocess: great-circle (haversine) distance in km to the ground-truth coordinate

metric.name: custom
metric.definition: mean great-circle error in km over the 43 verified grants (Table 4 also gives the median and the share within 10 km)
metric.original_location: Table 4, row M-2 o3-2025-04-16, column Mean (95% CI 17.4-29.3); median 14.3 km

notes: Small n gives wide CIs, which suits a seed-variance check. The ensemble row E-1 (five stochastic calls, 19.2 km) is a cheap extension. ~$0.05 per o3 call. || [hooks_2 2026-09-07] 43-grant set pinned from results/full_results.csv (is_locatable == 1); hook added; prepare verified (43 items, 129 requests).
